title: Sally Face Chapter 1 Walkthrough - Missables & Achievements
summary: A no-miss route for Strange Neighbors, including 5364, the Gear Boy, supernatural sightings and Charley's two tea outcomes.
quickAnswer: The most important early choice is the tea: sleeping aid and old laxative unlock different achievements. Enter 5364 in the dream, then collect the Gear Boy, batteries and basement cartridge before ending the Chapter.
imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of Sal in room 402 during Chapter One

steps.title: Secure the 5364 route in the dream
steps.body: Read the four visual clues and enter 5364 at the keypad. The correct code matters later for the Gear Boy achievement path, even though the door can be opened another way.

steps.title: Build the Gear Boy route before the investigation ends
steps.body: Pick up the Gear Boy in Sal's bedroom, batteries from the kitchen, the basement access route from Lisa, and the game cartridge from Lost and Found. Complete every available Gear Boy chapter before concluding.

steps.title: Clear the three hidden sightings
steps.body: For The Unknown, inspect the morgue body, the boarded wall-eye on the fifth floor, and the demon in Larry's kitchen. Do this while the building remains open for exploration.

steps.title: Choose and record a tea outcome
steps.body: Use sleeping aid with Addison tea for Go to Sleep, or the old laxative for Irritable Bowels. Finish one path, then replay the Chapter for the other.

mistakes: Entering a random dream code and losing the clean Gear Boy route.
Leaving the basement without the cartridge.
Assuming both tea achievements can be unlocked in one Chapter run.

faqs.question: What is the Sally Face Chapter 1 code?
Can I get both tea achievements in Chapter One?
faqs.answer: Not in one run. Replay the Chapter and choose the alternate tea mixture.

faqs.question: How do I get The Unknown achievement?
faqs.answer: Find the hidden body, wall-eye and demon in Larry's kitchen during the Chapter One exploration route.

gallery.caption: The dream provides the 5364 route clue.
Collect the Gear Boy and batteries before moving on.
Larry's apartment contains a hidden sighting route.

title: Sally Face Chapter 2 Walkthrough - Seals & Missables
summary: A player-first guide to The Wretched's four seals, room 403, Super Gear Boy routes and easy-to-miss achievement checks.
quickAnswer: Before the final investigation, scan every floor with the Super Gear Boy, revisit room 403 after getting the crowbar, finish the four seals and speak with Larry after each major discovery.
imageAlt: Official Sally Face Chapter Two supernatural investigation scene

steps.title: Use the Super Gear Boy as a missed-content detector
steps.body: A reaction is a reason to stop and inspect, not background noise. Revisit each Addison Apartments floor and clear the related spirit encounter before advancing the investigation.

steps.title: Do not leave room 403 for later
steps.body: After receiving the crowbar, return to the sealed apartment and talk to Mrs. Sanderson's ghost. This is an easy place to miss the Unseen path while following only the main objective.

steps.title: Treat the four seals as a checkpoint
steps.body: The Devour route depends on finding all four supernatural seals. Finish the associated Gear Boy sections while the building remains open, then check the achievement list before moving on.

steps.title: Follow up with Larry and Todd
steps.body: Return to Larry after the puzzle-box and building discoveries, then take the recovered chip to Todd. The main route continues, but these follow-ups carry optional context and achievement timing.

mistakes: Ignoring a Super Gear Boy reaction because the main objective points elsewhere.
Getting the crowbar but never returning to room 403.
Advancing after the puzzle-box without speaking to Larry or taking the chip to Todd.

faqs.question: How many seals are in Sally Face Chapter 2?
faqs.answer: There are four seals associated with the Devour achievement route.

faqs.question: How do I get into room 403?
faqs.answer: Get the crowbar during the investigation, then return to the sealed room in Addison Apartments.

faqs.question: What should I do with the puzzle-box chip?
faqs.answer: Bring the recovered chip to Todd after opening the puzzle box.

title: Sally Face Chapter 3 Walkthrough - Codes & Missables
summary: A focused guide to the timed journal route, school codes, Travis dialogue, journal pages and the Chapter Three completion checklist.
quickAnswer: Handle the timed prologue first, use 3141 for Mrs. Packerton's desk and 491145 for Henry's computer, then collect all eleven journal pages before the late basement route.
imageAlt: Official Sally Face Chapter Three classroom investigation scene

steps.title: Protect the timed journal route
steps.body: The white-room sequence is easy to rush. Set the controls before inputting the groups from right to left, then verify the reward path before starting the school investigation.

steps.title: Keep the two main codes separate
steps.body: 3141 opens Mrs. Packerton's desk; 491145 is Henry's computer password. Treat the clue source as the check, because using the right number in the wrong location is the common error.

steps.title: Handle Travis before the final school sequence
steps.body: Find Travis in the bathroom and use the empathetic 3-2-3-2 dialogue pattern for Atonement. The conversation is optional in the story but not for a complete Chapter clear.

steps.title: Count journal pages before the basement
steps.body: The Missing Pages route needs all eleven journal pages. Search the school, apartments and Gear Boy interactions before committing to late objectives that limit backtracking.

mistakes: Reading the white-room code in the wrong direction.
Using 3141 on Henry's computer instead of the desk.
Entering the basement route before confirming all eleven journal pages and Travis dialogue.

faqs.question: What is the Sally Face Chapter 3 timed code?
faqs.answer: Set the controls, then enter 9687, 96753, 47, 663, 63 and 6269 from right to left.

faqs.question: What are the Chapter 3 desk and computer codes?
faqs.answer: Mrs. Packerton's desk is 3141; Henry's computer password is 491145.

faqs.question: How do I get Atonement?
faqs.answer: Talk to Travis in the bathroom and choose dialogue options 3, 2, 3, 2.

title: Sally Face Chapter 4 Walkthrough - VHS Tapes & Room 103
summary: A focused route for the nine VHS tapes, five teeth, 435542 panel and room 103 point of no return in The Trial.
quickAnswer: There are nine VHS tapes. Finish the gallery and apartment routes, use the knife on the 201 panel with 435542, complete character-switching tape actions, then enter room 103 only after the checklist is clear.
imageAlt: Official Sally Face Chapter Four screenshot of the VHS tape archive

steps.title: Open the gallery route and enter 867
steps.body: Count the line values in the first three rooms. The clue reads 768 in discovery order; reverse it and enter 867 at Door 4. The route yields the later rune evidence needed for the apartment panel.

steps.title: Clear physical apartment routes
steps.body: Use 4035364 at the shed for PHANTOM, use the knife on the apartment 201 panel and enter 435542 for OTHERS, then inspect the building routes for BRIDGE and HUNGER.

steps.title: Use character switching for the late tapes
steps.body: SKIN, EVOLVE, RAGE and /// require the right Larry action before Sal can collect the result. Do not assume a tape is available to the same character who triggers it.

steps.title: Make room 103 the final check
steps.body: Verify all nine tapes, five teeth and optional dialogue before opening room 103. It closes the most important completion window in the Chapter.

mistakes: Using the discovery-order 768 instead of the usable 867 gallery-door input.
Entering room 103 before the character-switching routes are complete.
Collecting a trigger item as Larry but not returning to collect its result as Sal.

faqs.question: How many VHS tapes are in Sally Face Chapter 4?
faqs.answer: There are nine VHS tapes needed for Her Fate.

faqs.question: What is the Chapter 4 floor-panel code?
When is the Chapter 4 point of no return?
faqs.answer: Treat entering room 103 as the final completion checkpoint.

title: Sally Face Chapter 5 Walkthrough - Achievements & Secrets
summary: A focused completion route for 4035364, Todd's 13010 room, DOG colors, Escaping Death and Epilogue in Memories and Dreams.
quickAnswer: Chapter Five has seven achievements. Read every note, collect every color piece, use 4035364 at the shed, enter 13010 for Todd's room, and complete the whole Chapter without a game over for Escaping Death.
imageAlt: Official Steam screenshot of a Sally Face Chapter Five puzzle scene

steps.title: Clear Ash's home and the shed first
steps.body: Read Todd's notes, exhaust Neil's dialogue, collect the early color piece, then use 4035364 at the shed. The seven-digit code combines 403 with the Chapter One dream code 5364.

steps.title: Solve the smooth-cartoon route with the math intact
steps.body: Add 145, 5023 and 7842 for Todd's room: 13010. Complete the hexagons and all three pyramid inputs before leaving the route, because they feed the color-piece path.

steps.title: Finish the DOG color sequence
steps.body: At door five, enter white, black, blue, red, green, then purple. The sequence matters only after every color piece has been recovered.

steps.title: Protect the clean final run
steps.body: Escaping Death requires no game-over screen across every playable character. A Game Over ends the clean attempt, so start a fresh Chapter run before trying again; reserve final completion until Chapters One through Four are fully cleared for Epilogue.

mistakes: Entering a displayed number instead of calculating 13010.
Completing the final route after a game-over screen while pursuing Escaping Death.

faqs.question: What is the shed code in Sally Face Chapter 5?
How do I get Escaping Death?
faqs.answer: Complete the entire Chapter Five route without a game-over screen.
